failed_or_abandoned: 220-point log-grid kernels interpolated onto the analysis grid with c = 299792 km/s and a non-strict step: 5-23 % disagreement with direct WimPyDD calls at kinematic edges and Helm nodes; replaced by 1 keV kernels, c = 3e5 km/s and strict inequality (agreement 1.0000 at 14/15 test points)

Direct endpoint estimator from the maximum observed tungsten recoil: never approaches E+ (median E_max 253-690 keV for N = 3-3000 vs E+ = 1131 keV); replaced by full-shape Fisher/MLE plus a conditional above-300 keV Fisher showing the falling edge carries no delta information
L10 tungsten rate from WimPyDD's Gaussian single-particle spin response kept only as an order-of-magnitude value, bracketed by a zero-momentum-transfer spin estimate (0.050 vs 0.074)
wimpydd_generated_files: none (single-stream diff_rate calls write no response-function files; kernel cache output/work/P046/kernels.npz is our own)
